regime_context: Policy regime is an incentive-aligned yield-suppression and re-industrialization campaign: the Fed under Warsh holds a hawkish inflation-credibility line (Sept hike now >70% market-priced) while Treasury structurally suppresses front-end yields via bill issuance and buybacks, letting easing stay gated behind post-midterm inflation optics. Consensus reads this as coordinated easing; revealed interest is inflation-mandate first, with the Iran upside oil shock and weak June payrolls making the stagflationary split the main two-sided risk.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场激励相容的收益率压制与再工业化行动：沃什治下的美联储维持鹰派通胀信誉立场（市场已定价9月加息概率>70%），而财政部通过短债发行和回购结构性压低前端收益率，使宽松政策被挡在中期选举后的通胀观感门槛之外。共识把这读作协同宽松；而显示出的利益是通胀使命优先，伊朗上行油价冲击与疲弱的6月非农使滞胀裂口成为主要双向风险。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized oil-supply shock, and the reflation regime with energy as the top Q1 ETF-inflow sector re-primes the rotation; the administration's strong-dollar bridge does not suppress energy earnings.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂是已实现的石油供应冲击，而通胀回升体制与能源作为第一季度ETF资金流入榜首板块，重新点燃轮动；政府的强势美元桥梁并不会压低能源盈利。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
rotation_targeted energy (oil & gas) theme: FACT mechanism (headline-fragile)
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation or Hormuz risk premium unwind would deflate the oil bid, and headline-fragile energy underperforms if recession fears dominate the weak-jobs leg.
theses.dissent_zh: 快速降级或霍尔木兹风险溢价消退会压缩油价，而在衰退担忧主导疲弱就业这一侧时，对消息面脆弱的能源板块会跑输。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date despite no Iran de-escalation
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日之前，尽管没有伊朗降级，XLE仍落后SPY 5%

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's credibility-banking posture and >70% Sept-hike pricing push long duration against the strong-dollar, front-end-suppressed regime; real 10y at 2.29% leaves TLT vulnerable to hawkish follow-through.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什的信用储备姿态与超过70%的9月加息定价，使长久期资产在强势美元、前端受压制的体制下承压；10年期实际利率2.29%使TLT易受鹰派延续打击。
evidence: Dollar/debt theater: reinforces front-end Treasuries + low-real-yield regime
open_predictions: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026
fed_path_gap: market more dovish than Fed, gap -14bp
theses.dissent: A cracking labor market could force a data-driven September pivot, igniting a long-duration rally that the current hike pricing ignores.
theses.dissent_zh: 恶化的劳动力市场可能迫使按数据驱动的9月转向，引发当前加息定价所忽视的长久期反弹。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The 25% advanced-chip tariff and pending Section 301 handoff keep the domestic onshoring bid alive as a strategic-capital priority; a clean tariff continuation sustains the protection premium over the transition.
theses.thesis_zh: 25%先进芯片关税与待定的301条款交接，使国内在岸制造作为战略资本优先事项的需求持续；关税若干净延续，可在过渡期维持保护溢价。
evidence: China tech war theater: onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff
open_predictions: 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force
theses.dissent: A China truce that unwinds the tariff-protection premium or a clean 301 replacement failure would remove the onshoring bid and hit SMH relative to broad equities.
theses.dissent_zh: 若中美休战解除关税保护溢价，或301替代方案未能干净落地，将削弱在岸制造需求，使SMH相对大盘受挫。

falsifier.text: The 25% chip tariff is rescinded or the Section 301 handoff fails before the check-by date, and SMH lags SPY by 5%
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日之前，25%芯片关税被撤销或301条款交接失败，且SMH落后SPY 5%

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI industrial policy channels capital into strategic domestic capacity, with HALEU fuel-bank release and AI-reactor siting as catalysts that validate the fuel-cycle and advanced-reactor complex.
theses.thesis_zh: AI核电产业政策将资本引向战略国内产能，HALEU燃料库释放与AI反应堆选址构成催化剂，验证燃料循环与先进反应堆板块。
evidence: open_predictions: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU; AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program contracted/sited
thesis FACT mechanism: nuclear-for-AI steers strategic domestic capacity
theses.dissent: Advanced-reactor names are speculative and have already missed on similar calls; without a concrete sited project the policy narrative may not translate into relative performance.
theses.dissent_zh: 先进反应堆标的具有投机性，类似判断此前已失手；若没有具体落地项目，政策叙事未必转化为相对表现。

falsifier.text: OKLO lags SPY by 10% before the check-by date without a sited project announcement
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日之前，若没有落地项目公告，OKLO落后SPY 10%
